verdict.rationale: Loops documents LMX, a markup format authored in code and pushed through the Content API, which stays in sync with the visual editor. The API manages email content and themes, and LMX dynamic variables like {contact.firstName} resolve per recipient at send time; transactional sends also accept data variables. Keeping templates in version control is implied by code-based LMX authoring but is not documented as a first-party workflow. Missing for 10: an explicit version-control/git sync or CI deployment workflow, documented HTML/MJML support, clarity on pulling visual-editor edits back into code, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
